baseline: 35b84d4ffd774742ada41d33c39ab1a50551f113 plus identical pure AI query optimizations
design: Independent map/game seeds per match; equal randomized arm allocation within generator/size/format/mix strata, random seats and alliances. Matches are independent experimental units; no paired inference. Inputs accepted before treatment allocation. Deterministic seed replacements allowed only for rejected input generation before arm allocation, all rejections retained. No outcome peeking, optional stopping or replacement of failed gameplay attempts.
input_format: Maps generated by original format-158 binary, readable by both policies; no map conversion between arms
telemetry: Existing GLOB2_MEASURE/HISTORY, ECON, TL, TIMELINE. No new production instrumentation. Cumulative worker exposure from labour+filling counters; unit exposure approximate via left-rectangle TL population samples over observed ticks. Food critical exposure descriptive via measurement history, not exact unit-sync observations. Counters at final boundary must exist for every colony; malformed/missing telemetry is a technical failure, never zero.
analysis: 10000 independently stratified match bootstrap draws; matched numerator/denominator tuple resampling. Equal planned stratum weights, ratio of stratum-weighted mean totals. 10000 within-stratum label permutations, Holm correction over four primary endpoints. Two-sided 95% intervals; practical noninferiority only when full interval excludes prespecified harmful bound. Nonsignificance is not equivalence. Failure comparison includes every attempt; completed-game metrics are conditional on success and any unexplained differential failure blocks clean acceptance. Subgroup effects descriptive with intervals, no unadjusted discovery claims. Zero/rare event bootstrap intervals cannot establish absence of risk; disclose counts.
limits: Capped Linux x86-64 gameplay study, not full-match completeness, cross-platform determinism, save/replay/network admission, visual gameplay review, or authoritative performance benchmark. Final integration changes require relevant revalidation. No claim that these frozen builds already contain a merged final PR.
